body: 2026-10-16. Codex keeps a ChatGPT-plan login only as refreshable tokens in <home>/auth.json; copying it to another home risks refresh-token rotation, so `agx login add --provider codex --kind oauth-token` is refused and a plan account stays one profile per home. Codex api-key logins (V5) were not verified on purpose: checking needs a metered OpenAI API call; build only when the owner asks.
title: Codex: no plan-token logins; API-key logins unbuilt
